tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The estimate cost is inclusive of site visit charges. Consutant should quote his rates inclusive of site visit charges.
Consultant should submit 05 copies of all drawings approved by competent authority.
Consultant should submit 3D view documents approved by competent authority.
Consultant should submit editable Auto CAD copies approved by competent authority.
All other conditions as per Bid document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer Should have experience in Preparation of DPR and Structural Design of at least one similar Building works costing minimum Rs. 42.50 lakhs within previous five years.
The Consultants Company should be registered with companies should have a minimum of 10 years of Experience as a Consultants Company conducting similar assignments.

Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of Consultancy Services works only) of Rs. 85.00 Lakhs
